author: fenglin
model: Harness deterministic local fixture-one. Native rc.5 sessions, media and playback ran in the browser.

voice.input: Chromium file-backed microphone with steady noise, hum and short taps. Timed synthesized speech was mixed into its MediaStream. The application used its normal AudioWorklet and WebRTC detector.
voice.bundledModel: X-ASR-zh-en jointly decodes Mandarin, English and code-switched speech in the same recording on the host CPU.
phoneScenarios: Mandarin conversation using optional local PrimeTTS
Mandarin, English, then Mandarin/English mixed in one call with automatic input and output, using loopback speech synthesis.
voice.breeze: Unit tests exercise unchanged catalog voice voc_8yud7hz7c9q2, zh and en with breeze-tts-2, and complete mixed text with breeze-tts-2-multilingual. No credentialed Breeze run for this release.
voice.deviceSpeech: Unit tests exercise local voice selection per phrase, cancellation across mixed-language spans and captions when a required voice is unavailable.

Of course. Tell me your other question. I am listening.
我会 check the calendar，然后告诉你时间。

distribution: The accompanying GitHub Release verification JSON records post-pack runs on the distributed archive, including 0.4.5 installation, upgrade, restart, phone and camera.
limits: No credentialed Breeze production call in this release. Prior production synthesis evidence is in verification-0.4.3.json.
The browser ran on Linux with file-backed media, including a 390x844 viewport. No physical microphone/phone, physical loudspeaker, mobile OS, Electron Desktop, Windows or macOS run.
The supplied incident archive contains no microphone recording. Corpus results do not measure the original user utterances.
Live model reasoning, long-term learning, real signed-in video sites and the browser extension toolbar were not exercised.
